kind: local issue drafts; not a runtime board

issues.title: Harden the existing read oracle and outcome accounting
issues.scope: Keep the current read tasks; reject key/value substring false positives and unrelated counts. Include all attempts in success rate and spend, retain all-invalid cells in task-level outcome reports, and version the oracle.
acceptance: Negative cases reproduce the old false positives and pass after the fix.
Expected fixture facts match the actual SQLite seed.
One pass, one wrong answer, and one timeout produce 1/3 attempt success and total attempt spend divided by one success; zero successes produce null cost/success.

issues.title: Finish outcome validation and freeze comparable experiments
issues.scope: Strengthen final-message extraction using captured versioned event fixtures; classify ambiguous prose instead of accepting keyword presence. Snapshot expectations from the authoritative seeded store before execution. Add write oracles, then run a small matched read pair before a large matrix.
acceptance: Reasoning, earlier text, negated/contradictory statements, truncated messages, and multi-part finals cannot create a false pass.
Write checks compare before/after state, revision and event history; a pre-existing target value cannot count as a mutation. Completion checks distinguish passed, waived and not_configured evidence.
Report unknown/missing billing separately from zero; record runtime/source/prompt/oracle identities and interleave matched runs.
Product availability and same-backend schema ablation are separate experiments; neither declares a winner without comparable success.
issues.progress: Implemented structured read snapshots, message-aware final extraction, four SQLite write contracts, retained per-run evidence and incomplete-usage accounting. Remaining: additional write semantics/configured-gate evidence, stable runtime/source manifests, interleaved scheduling and live pilot.

issues.title: Close the named security coverage gaps
issues.scope: Turn T-01, T-02, T-03, T-04, T-11, T-12, T-13 and T-14 into explicit adversarial integration tests and a coverage register. Preserve existing T-05 through T-10 checks; do not equate unit counts with runtime isolation.
acceptance: Two live project locations cannot leak task, memory or event data, including model-supplied internal IDs.
Omitted locations fail closed; event payload filtering happens before sensitive payload processing/persistence.
Uninstall and invalid entrypoint behavior are verified; Code Mode audit truncation is explicit.

issues.title: Probe and pin runtime execution capabilities
issues.scope: Extend the existing V2 compatibility probe for agent/session creation, dispatch, cancellation, permission enforcement and reconnect. Verify the exact executable/package tuple; public SDK documentation alone is not acceptance evidence.
acceptance: Capture runtime version and immutable build identity per probe/run; desktop updates cannot silently change a matrix.
Exercise child sessions and project locations, cancellation, permission denial inside Code Mode, usage fields and duplicate dispatch semantics.
Unsupported read-only enforcement or idempotency is recorded as unavailable and blocks the dependent mode.

issues.title: Add accountable ownership and durable execution attempts
issues.scope: Implement ADR-0028 additively in core/db. Keep tasks, attempts and verification separate; add structured blockers/checkpoints and owner assignment with revision checks.
acceptance: Old database migration preserves tasks, public keys, events, revisions, memory and verification; repeat migration is safe.
A task survives failed/cancelled attempts without duplicate board cards; cross-project attempt links fail.
Execution success cannot mutate verification or bypass the task completion service.

issues.title: Persist immutable plan revisions
issues.scope: Add plan snapshots with objective, criteria, allowed scope, dependencies, content hash and revision history. Tasks reference revisions without replacing their existing acceptance text until a documented migration is adopted.
acceptance: An approved revision cannot be edited in place.
Scope changes create a new revision; attempts retain their original revision.
Historical plans and task links survive restart and migration.

issues.title: Implement fenced claims and writer-slot reservations
issues.scope: Implement ADR-0029 execution claims independently from index_jobs. Claim a primary execution and workspace writer slot transactionally; support separately bounded helper claims.
acceptance: Competing database connections/processes cannot acquire two primary claims or two conflicting writer slots.
Expired or superseded fencing tokens cannot renew, checkpoint, complete, release or fail the replacement execution.
Lease expiry changes admission authority but does not automatically assert the previous process stopped.

issues.title: Add trusted, scoped, revocable approval grants
issues.scope: Implement ADR-0030 grants through a trusted user/control path. Bind project, plan hash, operations, workspace/path scope and limits. Replace actor-string authority assumptions at autonomous waiver/dispatch boundaries.
acceptance: An agent cannot approve by supplying a human name or replaying a grant from another project.
Plan changes, expiry and revocation invalidate grants; work within an unchanged approved scope does not prompt again.
Waivers remain visibly waived and retain trusted approval provenance.

issues.title: Reserve and reconcile execution budgets
issues.scope: Add transactional model/provider allowlists, concurrency and spending reservations. Track known, pending and unknown usage for helpers, retries and failed attempts.
acceptance: Concurrent admissions cannot spend the same available reservation twice.
Duplicate/late usage events are idempotent; missing usage stays unknown and does not release an uncertain reservation.
Exhausted budgets deny new work; in-flight provider costs are explicitly not a guaranteed hard cap.

issues.title: Implement the native runtime adapter port
issues.scope: Define adapter-neutral capabilities, dispatch, status, cancellation and usage interfaces. Implement them using the verified OpenCode V2 surface and persist project/session mapping.
acceptance: Core imports no OpenCode types.
A session and event map to one trusted project/worktree context before use.
Unsupported capabilities fail closed; no fallback to another paid model or wider permission set.

issues.title: Compose transactional execution admission
issues.scope: Compose readiness, scope, grants, claims and reservations into one admission operation plus durable dispatch intent. Distinguish board-terminal dependencies from satisfied execution prerequisites.
acceptance: No runtime call occurs if any check fails.
A failed admission leaves no orphan claim/reservation; an admitted intent survives restart.
Archived or unverified dependencies cannot silently satisfy an artifact/verification requirement.
Only explicitly activated modes run; recursive spawning is denied and limits include the primary.

issues.title: Reconcile dispatch, cancellation and expired workers
issues.scope: Implement bounded event wakes and deterministic liveness checks with dispatch reconciliation. Recovery is required for read-only helpers too, before managed writing is introduced.
acceptance: Crash before dispatch, after accepted dispatch but before acknowledgement, and after result/commit never blindly launches a duplicate.
Pause/stop denies new admissions and cancels/reconciles existing sessions; ambiguous state becomes an operator-visible blocker.
No LLM is called for liveness polling; unchanged deterministic failures are not retried in a loop.

issues.title: Bind bounded context packages to tasks and source revisions
issues.scope: Reuse retrieval and memory to assemble dispatch context with task/plan references, acceptance criteria, file hashes, provenance, scope and resource limits. Add delta handoffs and explicit freshness checks.
acceptance: Changed source or plan invalidates the cached pack.
Untrusted/stale memory cannot become an execution instruction or trusted constraint.
Context stays within configured budget and includes omissions/uncertainty.

issues.title: Enable opt-in read-only research/review helpers
issues.scope: Implement assisted mode with at most three total agents including the primary and only the existing primary allowed to write. Helpers return attributed findings through the coordinator.
acceptance: Helper edit, unrestricted shell, task mutation, waiver, trusted-memory promotion, and recursive delegation attempts are denied.
If runtime permissions cannot enforce this, require a separately enforced environment or refuse assisted mode.
One approved dispatch produces one attributable result; helper failures cannot self-mark task completion.

issues.title: Expose execution state through existing RPC/dashboard
issues.scope: Add bounded execution projections to existing RPC and views: owner, attempt/session, state, blocker, freshness, usage and cancellation status. Preserve dashboard auth and project confinement.
acceptance: Stale observation and unknown usage are visible.
No raw reasoning or conversation is persisted as project memory.
No unsupported progress percentages; mutating controls use trusted grants and revisions.

issues.title: Validate assisted mode against a single-agent baseline
issues.scope: Run opt-in failure-injection and matched feature experiments. Freeze tasks, acceptance criteria, model/runtime configurations and corpus before evaluating delegation.
acceptance: Report successful accepted work, all attempt spend/tokens, elapsed time, failures and rework.
Cross-project, forged approval, denied tool, exhausted budget, crash and cancellation scenarios pass.
Installation alone creates no child sessions or paid traffic; ordinary single-agent use remains functional offline.

issues.title: Add one managed writing worker and reviewed integration
issues.scope: Introduce isolated worktrees, changed-file audits, exact commit/base recording and human-approved integration. This extends recovery to code side effects.
acceptance: Main checkout remains untouched by workers.
Unexpected writes, stale base, changed target branch and failing checks prevent integration.
Recovery inspects existing commits/artifacts before retry; cancellation does not claim rollback.

issues.title: Enable bounded concurrent writers and integration queue
issues.scope: Add scope reservations, conflict handling and a serialized integration queue only after single-writer validation.
acceptance: Graph predictions do not replace actual changed-file checks.
Candidate/target commits are revalidated at integration; conflicts and target regressions block landing.

issues.title: Evaluate adaptive routing and reusable workflows
issues.scope: Propose routing, decomposition and context/skill changes from verified historical outcomes; use held-out evaluations before activation.
acceptance: Quality, cost or latency improves on a frozen equivalent baseline.
No automatic activation of an untested skill or material plan change.

issues.title: Add optional persistent local coordinator
issues.scope: Host the same durable protocol outside interactive sessions. Add explicit scheduled authorization, reconciliation across restarts and optional notification/external adapters.
acceptance: No unattended work without a current grant; work is stoppable and recoverable after host restart.
External adapters do not introduce a competing task authority.
